{{Quote|It occured when I was watchman of this sector.|Tholme to [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]|<ref name="Star Wars 33">[[Star Wars (1998) 33|''Star Wars'' (1998) 33]]</ref>}}
The '''Kiffu sector'''<ref name="SWTCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] contained the [[Azurbani system]], home to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] and [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]. It was ruled by the [[Kiffu Guardians]], who were affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref> Both [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]], respectively, were appointed [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] of this sector.<ref name="Star Wars 33" />
